symptom: Adding one `@annotation(text: 'note D', position: (1500, 600), size: (200, 80))` to a described flow and re-running it as create or modify stored the note at x 3390 instead of 1500 and shifted the three later activities by +1180px; with size-only notes every activity after the first noted one shifted by +140..+280px. mx check: 0 errors. With @position on every statement nothing moved.
cause: Plain describe omits positions, so the re-noted statement is not declaredMatches and becomes a 1:1 Replace whose fragment is unplaced. fragmentGeometry boxed every fragment object, notes included: activity at 300..420 and note at 1400..1600 gave a 1300px box, Replace's `extra = length - size` shifted everything past the cut by 1180, and placeCentred translated the note with the box (1500 + 1890 = 3390). A size-only note is centred on its activity, so a 260/400px note made extra 140/280.
file: mdl/backend/mfmutator/splice.go (fragmentGeometry, placeCentred), mdl/backend/microflow_mutation.go (MicroflowFragment.Pinned), mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_builder_annotations.go (recordStatedNote), cmd_alter_flow.go (buildFragment), cmd_microflows_builder_flows.go (handler merge-back)
insight: The agent's arithmetic from source reproduced every reported number (1180, 3390), and the unit test then reproduced them in the mutator (b 420 -> 1600) before the fix — so trust the arithmetic, but run it. A note sits off its line and takes no room on it: leave notes out of the box the splice makes room for, translate an unplaced note with its activity, and leave a note with a stated (absolute) position where the script put it. Loop-body notes need no pin: they are children of the loop and move with its box. Still open: a note-only change is a Replace at all, so the activity gets a new $ID; an AddNotes op would keep it.
